Subject: Service availability Sept 3-4 — request for credit and reconciliation

Hi Marissa,

Following the incident on Sept 3-4 (incident id: RWI-2026-0903), we observed extended degraded throughput for our production inference endpoints between 23:40 UTC on Sep 3 and 06:10 UTC on Sep 4. Our internal telemetry records ~5.7 hours of reduced availability for the affected model instances.

Per our contract (SLA 99.9% monthly availability), we'd like to understand our eligibility for a service credit and the calculation you will apply. Please confirm what logs or artifacts you need from our side — we've attached a CSV extract of our application-side error counts for the window.

We'd like a written estimate of the credit amount and a timeline for issuance. Legal is cc'd for any paperwork.

Thanks,
Sanjay

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the quick note and for the CSV. I'm sorry for the disruption.

Quick status on our side: our incident postmortem is in progress. Initial findings show an autoscaling regression when a cross-tenant batch job saturated the shared GPU allocator — that triggered a series of fallback model variants with higher latency which contributed to the degraded SLA window. We've flagged a runtime fix (deployed Sep 5) and a routing policy change to prevent recurrence.

What we need from you to proceed with a formal credit calculation:
- Confirm the exact invoice period you want this credit applied to (Sep invoice? next cycle?)
- Any billing identifier or PO number to include on the credit memo
- If you have a preferred format for the calculation (spreadsheet), I'll ask Rishi to prepare one and include our telemetry and the official uptime windows.

I'm looping in Rishi (SRE lead) to run the formal availability math and Laura from finance for approval routing. We will provide a provisional number within 48 hours and a finalized credit memo within 7 business days, assuming no additional data required.

Attachments referenced: hickory_downtime_log.csv (received).

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi all,

Thanks for the logs, Sanjay. I walked through Redwood's production telemetry and correlated it to your CSV. Below is our provisional calculation — attached is a worked spreadsheet (proposed-credit-calculation.xlsx) showing the step-by-step math.

Summary of SLA terms used: monthly uptime target = 99.9% (per contract), billing period = calendar month (September).
Observed total downtime impacting your endpoints (per combined telemetry): 5.7 hours in the billing month.

Calculation method (standard per contract):
1) Monthly minutes = 30 days * 24 * 60 = 43,200 minutes
2) Allowed downtime for 99.9% uptime = 43.2 minutes
3) Observed downtime = 5.7 hours = 342 minutes
4) Excess downtime = 342 - 43.2 = 298.8 minutes
5) Pro-rata credit = (Excess downtime / Total monthly minutes) * Monthly recurring charge (MRC)

We used your MRC of $48,000 for the Redwood-hosted inference portion (from DEAL-4532).
Credit = (298.8 / 43200) * 48,000 = $332.44 (rounded to $332.44).

Notes and caveats:
- We run a reconciliation step to remove any time where your account had concurrent configuration changes that may have influenced availability; so far we found none.
- This provisional number assumes the incident window defined above and that Hickory accepts Redwood's telemetry as authoritative for the service side. If you provide any overlapping customer-side mitigation windows we will consider them in the final.
- Per the SLA, credits are capped at a single month's MRC and issued as account credits applied to billing.

Next steps:
- Sanjay, please confirm acceptance of the calculation and the invoice period to apply to.
- Finance (Laura) — can you confirm the procedural steps to generate the credit memo and timeline for application?

Quoted from the initial email for context:
> Following the incident on Sept 3-4 (incident id: RWI-2026-0903), we observed extended degraded throughput...

Thanks,
Rishi
SRE, Redwood Inference

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the patience. Finance has reviewed Rishi's provisional calculation. We will issue a credit memo in the amount of $332.44 to be applied to Hickory Systems' next invoice (September billing cycle), unless you prefer it applied to the October invoice.

Operational details:
- Credit memo draft attached: credit-memo-draft.pdf
- We need either a billing PO or confirmation that no PO is required. Please reply with the PO number or sign the attached acceptance (if needed) and we will finalize.
- Expected timeline: final credit memo within 3 business days after you confirm, credit applied within one billing cycle.

If Legal requires a signed mutual action plan for large credits we can accommodate, but for this amount a simple email confirmation is sufficient per our standard process.

Marissa — please advise if we should also issue a small goodwill credit (separate discretionary item) while the fix rolls out.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
